fns.desc: populate_type10_classifier_data(): dst array starts as a shallow os_memdup() of src, so filter_value/filter_mask on not-yet-processed elements alias the SOURCE's own allocations. If a later element's os_memdup() fails (:293,299) and the function returns -1, both callers (wpas_scs_reconfigure:695, wpas_send_scs_req:772) call free_up_tclas_elem() on the whole destination array, freeing the aliased source pointers -> double-free/UAF against the original scs_desc_elem/active_scs_elem list entry. Narrow (requires OOM mid-loop with num_tclas_elem>1) but real.
